# ===================================================
# DATABASE CONNECTION SETTINGS
#
# Instructions:
# 1. Rename this file to ".Renviron"
# 2. Place it in the R user's home directory on the server,
#    or in the specific project directory where the scripts run.
# 3. Fill in the correct credentials for each environment.
# 4. Maybe obfuscate the .Renviron file to .Renviron.enc (using pkg function)
# ===================================================

# --- Development Environment ---
DB_HOST_DEV="your_dev_server_address"
DB_USER_DEV="your_dev_username"
DB_PASS_DEV="your_dev_password"
DB_DSRC_DEV="your_dev_odbc_data_source"

# --- User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Environment ---
DB_HOST_UAT="your_uat_server_address"
DB_USER_UAT="your_uat_username"
DB_PASS_UAT="your_uat_password"
DB_DSRC_UAT="your_uat_odbc_data_source"

# --- Production Environment ---
DB_HOST_PRD="your_production_server_address"
DB_USER_PRD="your_production_username"
DB_PASS_PRD="your_production_password"
DB_DSRC_PRD="your_production_odbc_data_source"

# --- Labware 7 Environment ---
DB_HOST_LW7="your_production_server_address"
DB_USER_LW7="your_production_username"
DB_PASS_LW7="your_production_password"
DB_DSRC_LW7="your_production_odbc_data_source"
